propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is never read in production code outside config plumbing, making it inert and misleading

The per-language analyzer dispatch system (ANALYZERS registry, resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable) was designed in epic 839b but never wired into the metrics pipeline despite being shipped intentionally empty
The dispatch seam is not viable as designed because analyze_or_unavailable calls analyze with keyword argument 'languages' but scc_loc.analyze expects 'scan_roots', causing TypeError at runtime
load_lizard function duplicates the guard logic already present in lizard_complexity.analyze, making it redundant
The removal requires adding tombstone entries to _TOMBSTONE_REGISTRY for code_health.analyzers and REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ANALYZERS environment variable to prevent silent config drops
After removal, _as_str_dict becomes orphaned as it is only called by the analyzers coercion row being deleted
